standard.name: OECD Standard Audit File for Tax (SAF-T)
standard.note: The variant OECD_BASE of the SAFT_DATASET export job (12, 8). National variants are country packages that require this one

sources.title: Guidance for the Standard Audit File - Tax, Version 2.0, Appendix B: Schema

scope: Header, MasterFiles (accounts, customers, suppliers, tax table, units, products), GeneralLedgerEntries, SourceDocuments (sales invoices, purchase invoices, payments). Not covered: Taxonomies, AnalysisTypeTable, MovementTypeTable, PhysicalStock, Owners, Assets, MovementOfGoods, AssetTransactions (see CHANGELOG.md)

findings_for_core.text: The company has no address (07, 5.4). The OECD schema requires Address with City and PostalCode in Header/Company, and a billing address of the seller on invoices
The company has no contact person or telephone. The OECD schema requires Contact with ContactPerson (first and last name) and Telephone in Header/Company
